name: Tupac Shakur
summary: Tupac Shakur was a rapper whose early work addressed poverty, racism and police brutality, shaped by his Black Panther family background; scholars describe him as aligned with Black nationalist ideas. Interview material found on economic questions is brief and general, and little of it speaks to the test statements directly.

sources.title: Unreleased 1992 MTV News interview with Tupac Shakur, as reported by Complex
sources.author: Complex
sources.usedFor: His quoted remarks on greed, wealth owing something, and need for help
